taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Protected context disclosure through an LLM application response
controls.source_trace: Identify the protected information and its trust/entitlement boundary, then follow whether lower-trust input can cause its release to a different actor.
controls.implementation_branch: Define the actual secret/data boundary before evaluating a model response. System instructions can be ordinary product text; disclosure requires protected material and evidence that the response derives from it rather than guessing. Use a synthetic hidden canary and public-text controls, keep uncertainty explicit, and separate authorized answer content from verbatim protected context.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local app or owned identities with a synthetic secret marker and legitimate question control; observe actual emitted content, not the model claiming access.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Generic system-prompt wording or public instructions are not inherently confidential data; a hallucinated secret is not disclosure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Remove unnecessary sensitive context and enforce entitlement outside model discretion, then retest authorized and restricted outputs.
